name: Legend Sang 5
summary: Why are humans, though unable to wield magic, so obsessed with it? What is the essence of magic? Why do countless legends of magical creatures persist in a world devoid of them? What defines a "monster"? What is the nature of gods? What was wrong with the world of the past? What feels off about our world today? All these questions, reflections, and answers will gradually unfold in Legend Sang 5.
